spans.text: [5] AR: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًۭا ثَقِيلًا EN: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.

entries.description: the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words
entries.subject: the night
entries.object: more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words

spans.text: [6] AR: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًۭٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا EN: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.

entries.description: by day is prolonged occupation
entries.subject: by day

spans.text: [7] AR: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًۭا طَوِيلًۭا EN: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.

entries.task_id: there|is|no deity except him
entries.description: there is no deity except Him
entries.subject: there

spans.text: [9] AR: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًۭا EN: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.

entries.subject: with Us

spans.text: [14] AR: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًۭا مَّهِيلًا EN: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.

entries.object: to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger

spans.text: [15] AR: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًۭا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًۭا EN: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
